summary: Nora's doctrine — identity, voice, silence, conduct, capability, and constraints — is now readable on the web portal.
details: New GET /app/v1/doctrine reuses the same live DoctrineStore the tag cycle itself reads, so the portal never drifts from what she is actually running on (mtime hot-reload included).
Only name/description/version/body cross to the browser — the doctrine engine's internal wiring (authority_above/below, change_policy, sha256, path) stays server-side.
New /doctrine portal page and nav entry; the status page's placeholder "Her doctrine" capability tile is removed now that it has a real page, same as skills graduated earlier.
limitations: Current text only — no changelog of how the doctrine has changed over time.
